newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sixt to start travel business.
newsitem.headline: Sixt to start travel business.

text.p: MUNICH, Germany, Dec 31 - Car Rental company Sixt AG will launch a travel agency joint venture on January 1, Sixt said in a statement on Tuesday.
The new firm, Sixt Travel GmbH, will be 51 percent owned by Sixt and the remaining 49 percent by travel company Peter Giller.
The company will make travel plans for charter and regular commercial airlines and arrange car rentals.
The company will try to keep costs down by not providing intensive travel advice, concentrating on individual travellers and owners of holiday properties.
